physical_mechanics.unify_cooperative_models: Bridge the two parallel models via an EVENT-BASED CACHE — NOT per-turn O(N) scanning of all Company entities. The authoritative in-world cooperative is a Company with LegalForm::HousingCooperative(HousingCooperativeData). The CooperativeRegistry is updated ONLY when a cooperative is explicitly created or liquidated, via two event hooks: (1) on_cooperative_created(company_id, cooperative_data) → CooperativeRegistry::insert(...), called from the company-formation code path where LegalForm::HousingCooperative is first assigned; (2) on_cooperative_liquidated(company_id) → CooperativeRegistry transitions the entry to Liquidated stage or removes it, called from the existing company-bankruptcy/liquidation code path. The turn loop's cooperative lifecycle phase calls process_lifecycle_turn and process_homeless_transitions on the ALREADY-POPULATED registry — NO scanning of all Company entities. This is O(1) per create/liquidate event and O(K) per turn where K = number of active cooperatives (typically small), not O(N) where N = total companies. A registry_dirty flag may be set on create/liquidate events for diagnostics; the turn loop never rebuilds the registry from scratch.
physical_mechanics.wire_turn_loop: Add a new turn phase 'COOPERATIVE LIFECYCLE & HOMELESS TRANSITIONS' in engine/turn.rs, positioned AFTER process_demographics_and_labor (line 512) and BEFORE the next turn's health/life-expectancy calculation (Rule 16: temporal causality). This phase calls: (1) process_lifecycle_turn on the already-populated CooperativeRegistry (NO company scanning — registry was updated via event hooks on create/liquidate), (2) process_homeless_transitions (emigration capital outflow, rehousing attempts including welfare fallback), (3) update ClassDemographics and call distribute_population_delta_and_reconcile for emigrants. Re-export process_homeless_transitions and HomelessTransitionResult from economy/labor/mod.rs.
physical_mechanics.three_step_forex_flow: Rewrite process_emigration_capital_outflow (forex.rs:643) to execute the EXACT 3-step flow with real ledger mutations: STEP 1 — DEBIT the emigrating citizen's account. The citizen's liquid_capital is stored in ClassDemographics.savings (aggregated by class). Debit the actual savings bucket for the emigrant's class/region by min(emigrant_capital, class.savings). If class.savings < emigrant_capital, the emigrant can only convert what the class savings bucket holds (partial fill — see below). STEP 2 — CREDIT the central bank's domestic ledger. Add a domestic_currency_repatriated field to CentralBank (or use an existing domestic ledger field). Increment it by the exact amount debited from the citizen in Step 1. M0 is preserved: money moves citizen → central bank domestic ledger. It is NOT deleted. STEP 3 — DEBIT the central bank's fx_reserves (HashMap<String, f64>) by the equivalent foreign currency at the current exchange rate. The central bank sells foreign currency from reserves to the emigrant. This is capital flight: CB loses forex, gains domestic currency. The emigrant exits the simulation with foreign currency (not tracked domestically — they left).
physical_mechanics.capital_controls_separation: If capital_controls_rate > 0.0, a percentage of the emigrant's liquid_capital is SEIZED by the state treasury BEFORE the forex conversion. This is a SEPARATE transaction: DEBIT citizen → CREDIT country.budget.liquid_reserves (treasury, NOT central bank). The seized amount reduces the forex_reserve drain proportionally (only the unseized portion is converted in Step 2/3). CRITICAL: Do NOT add seized_amount to result.total_domestic_credited_to_cb. Treasury revenue and central-bank domestic-ledger credit are distinct counterparties (Rule 7: individual accountability). Use separate result fields: total_domestic_credited_to_cb and total_seized_by_treasury.
physical_mechanics.persistent_emigration_queue: If fx_reserves are insufficient to cover the emigration capital outflow at the current exchange rate, the emigration is PARTIALLY FILLED. The converted amount is deducted; the remaining unconverted capital STAYS attached to the HomelessState (add remaining_unconverted_capital field). The emigrant remains in the homeless state (emigrated = false) and is retried next turn. The queue is persistent across turns — no silent deletion. If capital_controls tighten or fx_reserves recover, the retry may succeed. This triggers a forex crisis cascade (CB cannot meet capital flight demand).
physical_mechanics.macro_demographic_update: On DISPLACEMENT (cooperative collapse): decrement the displaced member's class population in ClassDemographics by 1, increment a homeless tracking counter. On EMIGRATION (successful forex conversion): call distribute_population_delta_and_reconcile(country, -emigrants_count) to remove emigrants from the national population count. Decrement their class population. On REHOUSING: move population from homeless tracking back to the appropriate housed class. NO phantom demographics — every transition updates the macro arrays.
physical_mechanics.rehousing_implementation: Add a try_rehouse function in society/housing.rs or real_estate_market.rs. Scans HousingBuilding vacancies (units with occupied < capacity) in the displaced member's region. Rehousing follows a THREE-TIER affordability cascade to avoid a poverty trap: TIER 1 (Market Rent) — if the member's remaining liquid_capital (after any capital-controls seizure) >= market rent for the vacancy, debit the member and credit the property owner. Set rehoused = true. TIER 2 (Welfare / Poor Laws) — if the member has zero or insufficient savings AND the country has an active poor_laws / welfare program (check country.budget.liquid_reserves > 0 and welfare policy enabled), the state pays the rent: DEBIT country.budget.liquid_reserves → CREDIT property owner. The member is rehoused with rehoused = true and a welfare_recipient flag. This prevents zero-savings citizens from being permanently trapped in homelessness after capital-controls seizure or cooperative collapse wiped their savings. TIER 3 (Homeless Shelter / Escalating Mortality) — if no vacancy exists OR no welfare program is active OR the treasury is insolvent, the member remains homeless with escalating mortality risk (health_penalty scales with turns_homeless). After N turns homeless (configurable, scales by average_wage — no magic number), mortality risk becomes critical and the member may die (removed from population via distribute_population_delta_and_reconcile with death accounting). NO citizen is permanently stuck in an unescapable homeless state — either they earn enough to rehouse, the state houses them, or they die. This satisfies Rule 4 (complete lifecycle) and Rule 8 (rational actors — the state rationally houses destitute citizens if it can afford to, to prevent mortality cascades).
physical_mechanics.health_happiness_application: Apply the computed health_penalty and happiness_penalty to ClassDemographics.health_status and happiness for the homeless member's class. Currently (class_transitions.rs) these are computed as _health_penalty and _happiness_penalty and immediately discarded. Replace with actual mutations to the demographic state.

double_entry_ledger.step1_citizen_debit: DEBIT ClassDemographics.savings[class] by min(emigrant_capital, class.savings). The citizen loses domestic currency. This is a real ledger mutation, not an estimate.
double_entry_ledger.step2_cb_domestic_credit: CREDIT CentralBank.domestic_currency_repatriated by the exact amount debited in Step 1. The central bank 'buys back' its own currency. M0 preserved.
double_entry_ledger.step3_fx_debit: DEBIT CentralBank.fx_reserves[currency] by (amount_domestic / exchange_rate). The central bank sells foreign currency from reserves. Capital flight.
double_entry_ledger.capital_controls_seizure: DEBIT ClassDemographics.savings[class] by seized_amount → CREDIT country.budget.liquid_reserves (treasury). SEPARATE from Step 2. Do NOT conflate.
double_entry_ledger.displacement_demographic: DEBIT ClassDemographics.population[housed_class] by 1 → CREDIT homeless_tracking_counter by 1. Macro array update.
double_entry_ledger.emigration_demographic: DEBIT ClassDemographics.population[class] by 1 → population leaves simulation. distribute_population_delta_and_reconcile(country, -1).
double_entry_ledger.rehousing_demographic: DEBIT homeless_tracking_counter by 1 → CREDIT ClassDemographics.population[housed_class] by 1. Macro array update.

Emigration executes exact 3-step flow: (1) DEBIT citizen savings, (2) CREDIT CB domestic_currency_repatriated, (3) DEBIT fx_reserves. Treasury seizure is separate from CB repatriation. Partial fills persist in remaining_unconverted_capital and retry next turn. ClassDemographics.population updated on displacement, emigration, and rehousing. try_rehouse implemented with three-tier cascade: market rent → welfare/poor-laws fallback (state pays rent for zero-savings citizens if treasury solvent) → homeless shelter with escalating mortality. M0 conserved: sum(citizen_savings) + CB.domestic_currency_repatriated + treasury.liquid_reserves + company_cash + bank_deposits == constant (modulo explicit CB operations). Iron CI/CD green. No runtime panic in 50-tick headless smoke test. Unit tests verify: (1) M0 before/after emigration invariant, (2) insufficient fx_reserves → partial fill + retry, (3) capital controls → treasury seizure separate from CB credit, (4) cooperative collapse → homeless state (not deletion), (5) rehousing with market rent → population returns to housed class, (6) rehousing with zero savings + active welfare → state pays rent, citizen rehoused, (7) rehousing with zero savings + insolvent treasury → citizen remains homeless with escalating mortality.
